units.source_text: 不一会儿，茶馆老太婆把我领到另一个房间去。

en.t: Before long, the old woman from the teahouse led me to another room.

units.source_text: 这房间大概平常不用，没有安装门窗。

en.t: This room was probably not usually used, and it had no doors or windows installed.

units.source_text: 鸟瞰优美的幽谷，深不见底。

en.t: It looked down over a beautiful, secluded valley, so deep that the bottom could not be seen.

units.source_text: 我的肌肤起了鸡皮疙瘩，牙齿咯咯作响，浑身颤抖。

en.t: Goose bumps rose on my skin, my teeth chattered, and my whole body trembled.

units.source_text: 我对端茶进来的老太婆说了声：“真冷啊！”

en.t: I said to the old woman who came in carrying tea, "It is so cold!"
